[[Elections in the United States|Elections]] to the [[United States House of Representatives]] were held on November 3, 2026, to elect all 1,527 members of the House. No party won the 764 seats needed for a majority. The Republican-aligned bloc won 682 seats and the Democratic-aligned bloc 656, with 189 seats going to unaligned parties. [[Hakeem Jeffries]] was elected [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|Speaker]], replacing [[Mike Johnson]], with the support of the Democratic-aligned bloc and eight unaligned parties, 766 seats in all.

== Electoral system ==
The 1,527 members are elected by [[single transferable vote]] in multi-member constituencies within each state, with seats apportioned among the states by population.
